comments.body: You actually get the Caterina Dress version of this dress from the listed treasure map, not a purple one. I'm wondering now if this is even in the game yet?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The purple edition of this dress is not in the game right now, but will be one day:

fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-1223.html

Seems it will come from "Chamber of Commerce development district", as will many items. I suspect this will be released in the future during the Age of Revolution expansion, which comes after Atlantis finishes.
